metadata.description: Free plugins from Reliant Labs for coding agents: run agents in parallel safely, and deploy with no account.

plugins.name: parallel-agents-safety
plugins.description: Stop one agent from breaking the others: no pkill/killall, no nohup or stray &, no destructive git outside a worktree.

plugins.name: reliant-forge-deploy
plugins.description: Deploy a static site, a Vite or Next.js static export, or a Go API with Postgres to a live URL with no account; your user gets a claim link to keep it.
